# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve Becomes Pregnant with Cain

---

**1** Adam and Eve returned to paradise, and God appeared to them in a cloud of light.

**2** God said to Adam: 'I told you — you are from the earth and you will return to the earth. But I will also raise you back up from the earth at the last day. Then I will give you everything.'

**3** Eve conceived and gave birth to Cain, who was bright and radiant at birth.

**4** Adam took Eve and the child and brought them to the eastern side of paradise.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
